changelog:
Hivehome 1.0.1

- Updated code examples and quick reference for heating to use new pyhiveapi method names (e.g. getCurrentTemperature, getTargetTemperature, getBoostStatus, setBoostOn).
- Updated temperature limit references to use getMinTemperature and getMaxTemperature methods.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.
